title: Meeting recording
description: Whether a meeting's audio is recorded when the client that started it does not say, and whether the Stream Audio page and the browser extension may record screen video. The default is the shipped value, or the default profile's; a value set here is used instead until it is reset.
appliesText: A saved change applies to streaming meetings that start after the save, and to the next Virtual Participant to start.

recordAudio.title: Record meeting audio
recordAudio.description: Record the audio of meetings streamed to the WebSocket transcriber (the Stream Audio page, the browser extension and the desktop app) unless the client says otherwise, and of meetings a Virtual Participant joins, and store it with the meeting.

recordBrowserVideo.title: Record screen video from Stream Audio and the browser extension
recordBrowserVideo.description: On: the WebSocket transcriber accepts screen video streamed from the Stream Audio page and the browser extension, stores it with the meeting, and keeps its key frames as the meeting's shared-screen slides. Off: it refuses video from those two clients, and their meetings record audio only. The Desktop Capture App is not affected. Video is recorded only on a deployment with the EnableVideoRecording stack parameter set to true.
